multiple health problems. Specifically related to the endocrine system, vitamin C affects the regulation of several 
important hormones including insulin growth factor and sex steroids (Shi, Rath, & Niedzwiecki, 2021). Conversely, 
when evaluating the client’s nutrition status, there is potential to find excessive intake of nutrients. For example, a 
diet with excessive carbohydrate intake can increase blood glucose levels in individuals contributing to the 
development of insulin resistance and diabetes. Once nutritional imbalances are identified, the nurse can work with 
the client to make dietary changes and reduce the risk for developing endocrine disorders (Bickley et al., 2021).
